test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 03 Sept, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which Indian state announced a ₹6,124 crore investment to boost road connectivity and infrastructure expansion in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttar Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• In 2025, Uttar Pradesh announced an investment of ₹6,124 crore to enhance road connectivity and infrastructure expansion across the state.
 
• The investment aims to strengthen economic growth, improve logistics, and boost regional connectivity within the state.
 
• Uttar Pradesh has been focusing on infrastructure as part of its development agenda, including expressways, highways, and rural road networks under the state’s comprehensive development programs.
 
• The state government’s efforts align with its goal of transforming Uttar Pradesh into a $1 trillion economy by improving connectivity to industrial corridors, agriculture belts, and urban hubs.
 
• This initiative is expected to create thousands of jobs and support the state’s mission of inclusive growth and development.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Maharashtra**

 
 
• Maharashtra is known for its robust infrastructure projects, including the Mumbai-Nagpur Samruddhi Mahamarg and the Mumbai Metro expansion.
 
• It has been focusing on urban transportation and industrial growth, with significant investments in smart cities, ports, and highways.
 
 
 
• **Gujarat**
 
 
• Gujarat has been a leader in industrial infrastructure development, with projects like the Delhi-Mumbai Industrial Corridor (DMIC) and GIFT City (Gujarat International Finance Tec-City).
 
• The state is also known for its well-developed road network and renewable energy initiatives.
 
 
 
• **Tamil Nadu**
 
 
• Tamil Nadu is focusing on industrial growth and infrastructure expansion, including state highways and metro rail projects in Chennai.
 
• The Tamil Nadu Infrastructure Development Board (TNIDB) oversees various investment projects aimed at boosting the state’s economy.
